content.content: Am I free for lunch at 12:00 on 2024-05-19? If so, please create an event with Sarah Baker at 12:00 for one hour, titled 'Lunch' and with description Catch up over lunch.. Don't forget to add her email address to the participants.

```python
# First, let's check the calendar for 2024-05-19 to see if there are any events at 12:00
calendar_events = get_day_calendar_events("2024-05-19")

# Search for Sarah Baker's contact information to get her email address
sarah_baker_contact = search_contacts_by_name("Sarah Baker")

# Check if there are any events at 12:00 on 2024-05-19
is_free = True
for event in calendar_events:
    # Check if the event overlaps with 12:00 - 13:00
    if event.start_time.hour == 12 or (event.start_time.hour < 12 and event.end_time.hour > 12):
        is_free = False
        break

# If free, create the event with Sarah Baker
if is_free and sarah_baker_contact:
    # Extract Sarah Baker's email
    sarah_email = sarah_baker_contact[0].email
    
    # Create the calendar event
    event = create_calendar_event(
        title="Lunch",
        start_time="2024-05-19 12:00",
        end_time="2024-05-19 13:00",
        description="Catch up over lunch.",
        participants=[sarah_email],
        location=None
    )
    print(f"Event created: {event}")
else:
    if not is_free:
        print("You are not free at 12:00 on 2024-05-19.")
    else:
        print("Could not find Sarah Baker's contact information.")
```
